faculty.brief: P2M-2 minimal common collapse safety layer (2026-11-03): structural; no clinical threshold chosen
faculty.delivery: the certified effective oxygen-delivery deficit, not recalibrated, not replaced by D or lactate
faculty.gi_subset: 57m, demand 1.1, 17,604 rows, untreated pH < 7.00, MAP about 32.5-46.3, pulse present: diagnostic only, never used to choose a threshold, never classified as arrest / non-arrest while UNSET
faculty.order: EXPLICIT_LAG_REQUIRED: state(t) -> derive(t) -> collapse_signal(t) -> burden -> terminal decision -> terminal rhythm / pulse transition -> state(t+1); no recursive same-step loop
faculty.perfusion: MAP is the source; its clinical mapping stays UNSET_CLINICAL_MAPPING; synthetic tests may inject the normalized value
faculty.persistence: the existing aux.collapse_burden; no second persistence variable, no consecutive-minute counter; non-negative, 0 at arrival by default, arrival signal from the actual arrival physiology, rises while the signal persists, repays as it improves, tends monotonically to 0 at zero signal, never arrests alone, terminal needs persistence AND current non-viability, reset or frozen at the transition; never from tau_D, lactate or the encephalopathy memory; numbers UNSET
faculty.pulse: pulse_present is the effective perfusing rhythm state, not a guaranteed palpable pulse; pulse with an extremely low MAP is allowed as transient profound collapse; never derived from pressure
faculty.q_p_r: Q reaches MAP and DO2; P and R reach Q; rhythm stays authoritative for pulse_present; a no-pulse rhythm is arrest, not collapse
faculty.rosc: ROSC_NOT_CURRENTLY_MODELED; no ACLS; the architecture must not make a future ROSC impossible
faculty.scope: shadow only: no clinical threshold, GI collapse filtering, ROSC / ACLS, runtime activation, GI or second-family migration
faculty.signal: collapse_signal = MAX(perfusion_failure_signal, oxygen_delivery_failure_signal); never a sum; no Q, direct SpO2, P, R, lactate, D, pH, I or F as a graded input
faculty.spo2: direct SpO2 DEFERRED: oxygenation already reaches oxygen content and DO2; revisit in generalization
faculty.terminal_rhythm: TERMINAL_RHYTHM_PHENOTYPE_UNSET; the existing machinery only for structural tests
faculty.zero_flow: pulse=true + Q=0 stays an inconsistent state that fails loudly; not a clinical arrest rule; near-zero Q with a pulse stays representable

structural.C10: near-threshold burden + physiology restored -> burden decays, no delayed arrest
structural.C11: intermittent insults with recovery -> no indefinite accumulation
structural.C12: pulse=false -> Q / pressure / DO2 terminal consistency
structural.C14: pulse=true + near-zero Q / MAP -> representable profound collapse before arrest
structural.C4: both abnormal -> signal = max, not sum
structural.C5: Q changes with MAP / DO2 fixed -> no independent Q term
structural.C6: SpO2 changes with effective delivery fixed -> no direct SpO2 term
structural.C7: lactate / D / I / F (and pH) changed alone -> signal unchanged
structural.C8: one transient severe insult -> burden rises, no terminal transition (persistence required)
structural.C9: prolonged severe insult -> burden rises further and meets the synthetic terminal criterion

any loss of the pulse resets the burden; the terminal criterion reads the current signal, so a stale burden never arrests normal physiology
